state.signedOut: Not signed in to YouTube Music
state.signingIn: Sign in in the Google window, then close it. TekTube reopens by itself.
signin.hint: Opens Google's sign-in page in a normal browser window, with the address bar showing. Google blocks sign-in in TekTube's own window because the plugin remote-controls it. The window uses TekTube's own browser profile, and the plugin never sees your password or cookies.
resume.label: Resume where you left off
player.keys: Space play/⁠pause  ·  , . prev/⁠next  ·  ← → seek  ·  f like  ·  r radio  ·  t repeat  ·  x shuffle  ·  Tab views

queue.header.one: Up next  ·  %1 track  ·  g jumps to the current one
queue.header.other: Up next  ·  %1 tracks  ·  g jumps to the current one

transport.quit: Close YouTube Music (frees its memory; you stay signed in)
